hook: Your staircase here goes thirteen storeys straight down.
title: A 13-Storey Staircase Into the Ground
description:
Chand Baori in Rajasthan is a stepwell with about 3,500 steps arranged in perfect geometric patterns. It drops 13 storeys down. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #ChandBaori #Rajasthan
